_doc: coldpath agent on the luceneutil host: one arm per storage. Each arm's data_path is luceneutil's INDEX_DIR_BASE of that storage (<base>/indices), so /cache/residency?uuids=<index name> checks <base>/indices/<name>/index/ and <name>/facets/ (residency_dirs; the taxonomy index of the facet tasks) and /cache/drop pages out the SearchPerfTest JVM's mappings under it; the walk never enters the Lucene checkouts. No OpenSearch node: start/stop are no-ops and /node/restart is not used.
